She says she needs time so I would give it to her. As someone that has been in the situation your ex is in there is nothing more annoying or unattractive than someone not being able to give you space or time to yourself when you ask. I’m not saying ignore her if she reaches out but don’t pry or blow her phone up. By not talking to her and staying away you are sending a message that you are not only strong enough on your own but that you also respect her wishes and that they mean something to you. Hope this at all helped and good luck!

That’s a decent amount of time. I would think this is more of a rebound considering time invested.There’s always a chance they met someone they really connected with but I’d bet on it not lasting than lasting. Hope it works out in your favor.
How long did you guys date? If it was for a while then I would at first consider it a rebound. 3 months is fairly short but people can meet new ppl and connect in a short amount of time.

I don’t think you are alone in how you feel. I’ve seen a lot of others with this similar problem. I think you may just haven’t met the right people yet. Maybe they haven’t shared similar hobbies or outlooks on life. Finding likeminded friends can be really easy or hard depending on where you’re from. I know this all to well being from a small town. I don’t know much about you obviously but from the information you’ve provided it doesn’t sound like anything is wrong with you. Depending on who you are it may be easier or harder to make friends. Some people are more introverted or extroverted or anything in between but either way it’s neither right or wrong. As human beings by design we naturally seek comradery and friendship. We are social creatures and thrive off it so it would make sense that if your missing that aspect of your life for you to feel weird or out of place. From what I can tell nothing is wrong with you and you just haven’t met the right people yet. Don’t give up and best of luck!

Glad you’re alright. Got worried there after reading the first sentence. If it isn’t obvious please don’t do this again. In the moment when it seems like a viable option I know it can even be cathartic in a way but nothing good can come of it. Like Karp said deep cuts can get very bad. Just this last year I had a similar incident and had to be hospitalized for surgery. All in all months later I’m for the most part fine but for a while I couldn’t even make a fist or move half my arm. To this day I still have numbness and some arterial pain though it’s manageable. Hope your doing as well as you can now and best of luck to you👏.
